away.summary: The Minnesota Wild return home after a three-game road trip, riding a three-game win streak against Vegas. Jesper Wallstedt is projected to start in goal with Calvin Pickard as backup. The Wild will be without Marcus Foligno (mid-body injury), Nick Foligno (upper-body injury), Brock Faber (skull fracture), and Filip Gustavsson (lower-body injury), with Foligno listed as day-to-day and doubtful.
